source: The compiled defaults of ps::drivetrain::LimitPolicy, entry by entry (increment L0, owner decision 2026-10-13: refusal limits and advice thresholds are configuration). Every number is the literal that was a constexpr in core/src/drivetrain/limit_thresholds.h / engine_rules_table.h before L0, with its source text. tests/unit/test_limit_policy.cpp asserts this file equals the compiled defaults entry by entry.

boost_band_near.source: [AS] >> the 20 Pa ripple measured on the hyper (PHYS-058)

rotor_limiting_fraction.source: [AS] 3 % below the table edge: within the turbine's reach in one more step of load

surge_min_window_fraction.source: [AS] 2 % of the window (~10 substeps at 960 Hz x 0.5 s)

soft_cut_near_bands.source: [AS] two bands below the zero-fuel rpm

piston_speed_limiting_mps.source: [AS] F1 2.4 L V8 era peak ~25 m/s, recalled

kit_lambda_near.source: [AS] recalled tuning-guide ceiling for a safe wet shot (~12.5:1 gasoline = 0.85, plus margin)

kit_lambda_limiting.source: [AS] stoichiometric: no fuel margin left under the shot

kit_lambda_exceeded.source: [AS] 10 % lean of stoichiometric: the shot burns the engine

kit_lambda_target.source: [AS] middle of the recalled 0.78-0.85 wet-shot range

bottle_duration_near_factor.source: [AS] Near below target x 1.1: the same 10 % as the Closed remedy reserve, so a bottle sized to the remedy margin is just clear

bottle_reserve_factor.source: [AS] ~10 % of the liquid stays below the pickup

bottle_flow_retention_near.source: [AS] a 10 % flow loss over one pass is visible on the power

knock_near_retard_deg.source: [D] the knock search's own 0.05 deg bisection tolerance (knock.h)

knock_limiting_retard_deg.source: [AS] ~1-3 % torque on the generated eta_spark curves

intake_d_over_bore_1v_min.source: [AS] Heywood 1988 sec. 6.3 recalled (2-valve heads ~0.4-0.5 of bore), widened by 15 %

intake_d_over_bore_1v_max.source: [AS] Heywood 1988 sec. 6.3 recalled; just above the Ford Kent 0.475 (recalled)

intake_d_over_bore_2v_min.source: [AS] 20 % below the A25A-FKS 0.36 (repo [AS], Heywood Table 6.2 recalled 0.35-0.37)

intake_d_over_bore_2v_max.source: [AS] widened over the hyper 0.413 [M] and the Honda K20A-like 0.407 (recalled)

exhaust_over_intake_max.source: [AS] design section 6.2; the hyper (34/38 = 0.895) is the closest shipped engine

pack_share_of_ideal.source: [AS] the hyper packs 0.89 of the ideal 4-circle density [M]; 0.95 leaves it 6 % of room and still refuses valves with no web between the seats

rod_over_crank_radius_min.source: [AS] design section 6.3; Heywood sec. 2.1 recalls R = 3-4 for small and medium engines. The Toyota A25A-FKS (155.1 / 51.7) sits exactly on it [M]

cr_na_min.source: [AS] production gasoline engines since the 1980s run 8-14

cr_na_max.source: [AS] Mazda SkyActiv-G 14.0 (recalled); the A25A-FKS runs 13.0 [C] SAE 2019-01-0249 via the repo data

cr_forced_max.source: [AS] design section 6.3: no knock model, so forced induction is limited to <= 10.5

grid_overshoot_limiting.source: [AS] 5 % past the last node: clamped numbers start to matter (the shipped demo I4: limiter 6800 over a 6500 grid = 4.6 %)

cam_switch_over_limiter_min.source: [AS] Honda VTEC 0.60-0.72 of the limiter (B16A, K20A DC5/FD2, F20C; sources in the comment above), widened

cam_switch_over_limiter_max.source: [AS] Honda VTEC 0.60-0.72 of the limiter, widened; above it the high cam serves a sliver of the band

cam_switch_hysteresis_min_rpm.source: [AS] below ~50 rpm a WOT pull's speed ripple toggles the solenoid (no OEM hysteresis found)

cam_switch_hysteresis_max_rpm.source: [AS] beyond ~1000 rpm the engine runs the wrong cam for a large part of a lift (no OEM hysteresis found)

cam_peak_lift_over_valve_d_max.source: [AS] 0.35 seen on an aftermarket K20 race cam (junauto.co.jp), widened; beyond it more lift adds no flow area and stresses the valve train

lift_min_node_peak_min_mm.source: [AS] below ~0.1 mm the valve barely leaves its seat (BMW's second-generation minimum is 0.18 mm, fenderbender.com Scot Manna 2017)

lift_min_node_peak_max_fraction_of_full.source: [AS] BMW N52 0.18 of 9.9 mm = 0.018 (fenderbender.com; mymotorlist.com); above a quarter of full lift the throttle sets the light loads

gearbox_rating_over_limiting.source: [AS] transmission plan 7.1: 5 % over the rating; a gearbox is rated with margin, so the first few percent over are a warning (no gearbox wear model exists)

gearbox_rating_over_exceeded.source: [AS] transmission plan 7.1 / owner 2026-10-13 (Q7): more than 15 % over the rating is refused

gearbox_rating_remedy_margin.source: [AS] transmission plan 7.1: required rating = peak x 1.1
